description: DS-to-DS federation endpoint: fetch and consume a key package for a local user, requested by a remote DS for adding the user to a conversation.

main.description: Return and atomically consume one key package for a local user. The caller must be either the sequencer DS for the conversation or a participant DS in the group. The oldest available, non-expired key package is claimed.

recipientDid.description: DID of the local user whose key package is being requested

convoId.description: Conversation identifier the key package will be used for

keyPackageHash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the consumed key package

errors.name: ConversationNotFound
errors.description: The conversation does not exist on this DS

errors.name: RecipientNotFound
errors.description: The recipient DID is not a member of the conversation

errors.name: NoKeyPackagesAvailable
errors.description: No unexpired, unconsumed key packages are available for the recipient

errors.name: AuthFailed
errors.description: JWT validation failed or the calling DS is not authorized for this conversation
